metas.name: 1. Moonshine River
metas.description: Bart will be visited by many of his past girlfriends.

metas.name: 2. Treehouse of Horror XXIII
metas.description: A black hole threatens to swallow Springfield, Homer tries to find the source of paranormal activity, and a "Back to the Future" parody in which Bart keeps Marge from marrying Homer.

metas.name: 3. Adventures in Baby-Getting
metas.description: When Marge's car falls into a sink hole, she buys the perfect replacement to fit her family of five. But she quickly grows to hate it because, as she tells a shocked Homer, the car would be too small if she wanted to have another baby. Meanwhile, Bart and his friends are determin

metas.name: 4. Gone Abie Gone
metas.description: Homer and Marge try to track down Grampa by following clues that lead to secrets from his past.

metas.name: 5. Penny-Wiseguys
metas.description: Homer is shocked to discover that his bowling teammate is an accountant for Fat Tony and his mob. When Fat Tony gets jury duty, he appoints Dan as the temporary don of the mafia. Meanwhile, Lisa adds insects to her vegetarian diet after she passes out in the middle of a saxophone

metas.name: 6. A Tree Grows in Springfield
metas.description: Homer wins a MyPad at the school auction and Steve Mobbs, who is now in heaven, talks to Homer through it. Homer goes into a funk when he breaks the myPad, until Ned Flanders discovers a miracle tree in the Simpsons' back garden.

metas.name: 7. The Day the Earth Stood Cool
metas.description: A "cool family" from Portland moves in next door to the Simpsons. Homer is desperate to befriend them, while Marge is skeptical, thinking that being cool is not all it's cracked up to be.

metas.name: 8. To Cur, with Love
metas.description: Grampa has to move into the Simpsons house following a fire at the retirement home, and on moving day, Homer 'throws his back out' and 'rests' at home. He later finds an advert for a video game, Villageville on his myPad, and starts playing. During that time, Homer loses Santa's

metas.name: 9. Homer Goes to Prep School
metas.description: Homer joins the "Springfield Preppers," an off-the-grid survivalist group whose leader has set up a top-secret retreat outside of town to prepare for the end of the world.

metas.name: 10. A Test Before Trying
metas.description: The fate of Springfield Elementary rests on Bart and his test scores, and Homer finds way to make money with his own parking meter.

metas.name: 11. The Changing of the Guardian
metas.description: A tornado touches down in Springfield which sucks up Santa's Little Helper. While Homer and Marge are out looking for the family dog, the tornado strikes again and almost takes Marge and Homer. Marge is distraught about the kids and decide to pick a  guardian to care for the chil

metas.name: 12. Love Is a Many-Splintered Thing
metas.description: Bart's dream girl, Mary Spuckler, comes to town, but his failure to pay her enough attention is having a negative impact on their relationship. Meanwhile, Homer once again runs afoul of Marge and lands in the doghouse.

metas.name: 13. Hardly Kirk-ing
metas.description: Bart and Milhouse explore the perks of adulthood following a shaving experiment.

metas.name: 14. Gorgeous Grampa
metas.description: Homer's obsession with the TV show "Storage Battles" leads the family to discover Grampa's past identity as "Gorgeous Godfrey," the most feared, villainous man in pro-wrestling history

metas.name: 15. Black-Eyed, Please
metas.description: When Flanders' parents prove to prefer Homer's company to his, he jealously responds by giving Homer a shiner, and then tries desperately to reconcile with him. Meanwhile, Lisa is at a loss to understand why a new substitute teacher is bullying her for no obvious reason.

metas.name: 16. Dark Knight Court
metas.description: Springfield's Easter is ruined by a prank and all fingers point to Bart. It is up to Lisa to save her brother, in a student court presided over by Attorney General Janet Reno. Meanwhile, inspired by an old comic book, Mr. Burns becomes an ineffectual superhero—fruit bat man.

metas.name: 17. What Animated Women Want
metas.description: Homer's behavior once again lands him in hot water with Marge and he needs to fathom a way to save his marriage, while a dose of "A Streetcar Named Desire" drives Milhouse to affect a Marlon Brando-esque bad-boy demeanor in an effort to impress Lisa.

metas.name: 18. Pulpit Friction
metas.description: Homer is recruited to be a deacon by the cutting-edge new pastor. The dry cleaner mistakenly switches Marge's wedding dress for one of Krusty's costumes.

metas.name: 19. Whiskey Business
metas.description: Moe is flying high after venture capitalists take a shine to his homemade whiskey, while Grampa, after injuring himself babysitting Bart, decides he'd rather be looked after by his grandson than be at the nursing home. Also, Lisa voices her displeasure at a hologram of music lege

metas.name: 20. The Fabulous Faker Boy
metas.description: Marge encourages Bart to explore his creative side, and his initial reticence quickly subsides when she hires Slava’s beautiful daughter, Zhenya, as his new piano instructor. Homer is shocked when he loses the last two hairs on his head, and employs a wide variety of headgear to

metas.name: 21. The Saga of Carl
metas.description: Homer, Moe, Lenny and Carl win $200,000 in the Springfield Lottery. But when Carl takes off to Iceland – his homeland – with all the winnings, the guys embark on a Nordic adventure to get the cash back.

metas.name: 22. Dangers on a Train
metas.description: When Marge tries to buy Homer snack cakes for their anniversary, she winds up meeting a married man who shares a common love of British Television. Ignorant of all, Homer attempts to secretly construct a romantic anniversary train in the Simpsons back yard.
